pregame.whyWatch: Division game: the Giants lead the NFC East at 3-1; the Commanders are 1-3, 4th.
pregame.pressurePoint: Giants pass game vs Commanders pass defense. The Giants are No. 12 of 32 in pass explosiveness (1.38) and No. 21 in pass success rate (44%). The Commanders rank No. 26 at limiting explosive passes (1.38) and No. 24 in pass success allowed (48%). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. The Giants have the deep ball available. Watch whether the Commanders roll a safety over after the first one. Watch the first deep shot. If it connects, the Commanders change shells and the run game opens.
